sloka: तं दृष्ट्वा भरत: श्रीमान् मुमोह सहबान्धव:।अत्र राम इति ज्ञात्वा गत: पारमिवाम्भस: ॥ २.९८.१७॥
transliteration: taṁ dṛṣṭvā bharata: śrīmān mumoha sahabāndhava:।atra rāma iti jñātvā gata: pāramivāmbhasa: ॥ 2.98.17॥

translations.english: On seeing the smoke, majestic Bharata in the company of relatives concluded that Rama was staying there and rejoiced like a man who had reached the other bank of the river.
